summary: This Form 8-K filed by InPoint Commercial Real Estate Income, Inc., a Maryland REIT, solely reports a routine distribution declaration. The board authorized gross distributions of $0.1042 per share across all classes of common stock (A, D, I, P, T), with net distributions after stockholder servicing fees of $0.1014 (Class D) and $0.0946 (Class T). The record date is April 30, 2026, with payment on May 19, 2026. The distributions will be paid in cash. There are no special situation elements—this is a standard quarterly or monthly distribution announcement for a REIT, unrelated to any event-driven category.
